faqs.question: Which platform do you recommend: Shopify, WooCommerce, or bespoke?
faqs.answer: For most retail businesses requiring dependable reliability, seamless payments, and low maintenance, Shopify is our top recommendation. For businesses with complex existing WordPress workflows or unique bespoke product configurators, WooCommerce or a headless setup provides greater architectural freedom. We help you choose the right platform based on your operating model.

faqs.question: How do you help prevent shopping cart abandonment?
faqs.answer: Cart abandonment is usually caused by slow load speeds, hidden shipping fees, complex account registration forms, and lack of trusted payment options. We engineer stores with transparent shipping calculators, guest checkout by default, instant mobile payment options (Apple Pay, Google Pay), and lightning-fast checkout rendering.

faqs.question: Can you migrate my existing products, customers, and order history?
faqs.answer: Yes. We manage secure migrations from platforms such as Magento, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, or custom legacy systems into modern Shopify or WooCommerce installations, ensuring customer accounts and SEO URL structures remain protected.

faqs.question: Will our team be able to manage orders and add new products independently?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. You receive full training on daily operations: processing orders, managing inventory, printing shipping labels, creating discount codes, and adding new product collections without touching code.
